newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bids seen at record lows at Portugal bond auction.
newsitem.headline: Bids seen at record lows at Portugal bond auction.

text.p: Bids at today's auction of Portuguese 10-year fixed rate Treasury bonds should stand at record low levels of between 7.90 and 8.00 percent, dealers said.
"At this auction bids will stand at between 7.90 and 8.00 percent in line with the secondary market, which reflects the sharp drop in rates over the past month," a fixed rate director said.
Results of the auction of 20 billion escudos of February 2006 bonds are due around 1000 GMT today.

At the last auction on September 3, the Treasury placed 10.93 billion escudos of February 2006 bonds at a weighted average interest rate of 8.7228 percent. The maximum offered rate was 8.73 percent and the minimum was 8.70 percent.
Yesterday on the Continuous Market 272,470 February 2006 bonds traded and fell 30 escudos to 11,035 to yield 7.88 percent, with a spread of three basis points below January 2006 Bonos.
